entities.name: OA flexion test rule
observations: In standard osteopathic exam teaching, worsening occipital sulcus asymmetry during cervical flexion indicates an OA extension dysfunction; flexion is restricted.

entities.name: PMID:25429887
observations: In Phaseolus vulgaris, foliar treatment with live Colletotrichum gloeosporioides or pathogen fragments significantly reduced rhizobia-elicited root nodule number and arbuscular mycorrhizal fungal colonization versus controls.
The study observed induced defense responses, including increased foliar PPO, chitinase, and beta-1,3-glucanase; root PPO also increased.

entities.name: Phaseolus vulgaris
observations: Common bean host in the primary experiment testing aboveground pathogen effects on belowground rhizobial nodulation and AMF colonization.

entities.name: Colletotrichum gloeosporioides
observations: A live aboveground fungal pathogen and pathogen fragments reduced both rhizobial nodule formation and AMF colonization in Phaseolus vulgaris.

entities.name: Dual symbiont inhibition
observations: Inoculated common-bean foliage treated with live Colletotrichum gloeosporioides or its fragments showed significantly fewer rhizobia nodules and lower AMF colonization than controls.
